adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is initialized as either `[eventType.destinationCalendar]` or `[organizerUser.destinationCalendar]` (fallback), then for COLLECTIVE events it appends `teamDestinationCalendars` gathered from `users.slice(1)` (i.e., non-organizer members). This makes the set of destination calendars depend on whether `eventType.destinationCalendar` is set: when it is set, the organizer’s personal `destinationCalendar` is not included, while other members’ personal calendars are appended. The diff shows this asymmetry, but whether excluding the organizer’s personal calendar in that configuration is incorrect vs intended behavior isn’t verifiable from the diff alone.
